technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present early reversal signals, but overwhelming bearish technicals (all MAs bearish, negative MACD, three black crows, price below VWAP) and lack of bullish confirmation make this a high-risk entry with poor confluence.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 85 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) with recent bipartisan congressional purchases 86-87 days ago suggest contrarian buy opportunity, though conviction is moderate and news sentiment unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (302.6), rising dollar headwind for multinational ACN, and imminent FOMC event; earnings in 85 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly hostile.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14, Williams %R) combined with contrarian congressional buying 86-87 days ago and fear-zone sentiment (15/100) create a classic reversal setup with price near support at 247.17.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overwhelming bearish confluence—all moving averages bearish, price below all key MAs, negative MACD histogram, three black crows pattern, CMF negative, no bullish crossovers, zero fundamental catalysts, and hostile macro (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC imminent) make this a low-probability entry despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14) and contrarian congressional buying 86 days ago present reversal signals, the overwhelming bearish technical confluence (all MAs bearish, three black crows, negative MACD, price below VWAP) combined with hostile macro (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC imminent) creates unacceptable risk-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Macro deterioration (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, FOMC event) and complete absence of bullish confirmation despite oversold technicals suggest reversal may not materialize; earnings in 85 days adds timing uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all bearish; only sentiment offers contrarian support but insufficient to override consensus
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 2 other IT holdings in 20-position portfolio creates sector concentration; skip preserves dry powder and reduces redundant exposure.
